children: On August 24, 2026, the company received notice from Nasdaq that it no longer complies with Listing Rule 5550(b)(1) requiring at least $2.5 million in stockholders' equity and does not meet the alternative standards. The company has 45 days (until October 8, 2026) to submit a compliance plan, with a possible extension of up to 180 days if accepted; trading continues on the Nasdaq Capital Market under SCKT.
